notes.title: Retro Horror Adventure Now Haunting PC: Dark Fear
notes.content:
Dark Fear [official site] is part adventure game and part RPG, with similarities to Horror Soft’s titles from back in the day. I first played it on a tablet and am pleased to see it make an appearance on PC. It’s the kind of retro game that imitates its inspirations but also builds on them. It managed to startle me a couple of times, although I was playing in bed, lights off and headphones in, at some small bewitched hour. Trailer below.
